user.title: Choose your scale
user.description: Bluetooth devices seen by Home Assistant (including ESPHome Bluetooth proxies). Step on the scale to wake it so it shows up.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Set up {name}?
bluetooth_confirm.description: A compatible Bluetooth scale was found. Keep it awake (step on it) while you finish setup.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.description:
The scale calculates body fat, water, muscle and bone mass itself from this profile, so it is stored on the scale ({name}).

**After you submit: step on the scale within 30 seconds, barefoot, and stay on until it finishes.** Home Assistant can only write your profile to the scale and link your weight to it while the scale is awake. The first weigh-in is what teaches the scale to recognise you by weight.

More people can be added later from this scale's page (Add person).

data_description.nickname: Shown on the scale display. Must be unique per person.
data_description.activity: 1 = none … 5 = extreme athlete (affects the body composition formulas).

abort.already_configured: This scale is already set up. To add another person, open the scale in Devices & Services and choose Add person.
abort.no_devices_found: No Bluetooth devices found. Step on the scale to wake it and try again.

user.title: Add person
user.description: Each person on the scale needs their own profile and a unique nickname. After you submit, **step on the scale within 30 seconds, barefoot,** so it can learn to recognise you by weight.

data_description.nickname: Shown on the scale display. Must be unique per person.
data_description.activity: 1 = none … 5 = extreme athlete (affects the body composition formulas).

reconfigure.title: Update profile
reconfigure.description: Changes are written to the scale the next time it is used.

error.nickname_in_use: Another person on this scale already uses that nickname.

delete_scale_user.name: Delete scale user
delete_scale_user.description: Remove a user slot from the scale. It is deleted the next time the scale wakes up. People configured in Home Assistant cannot be deleted this way; remove them from the integration instead.

uid.name: User ID
uid.description: The uid shown in the attributes of the 'Users on scale' sensor.

invalid_uid.message: The user ID must be a hexadecimal value from the 'Users on scale' sensor.

uid_in_use.message: User {uid} belongs to a person configured in Home Assistant. Remove that person from the integration instead.
